profile.name: TCP/IP网络连接适配器
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于实验控制软件通过套接字与仪器或网络服务建立TCP/IP通信。它负责打开和关闭连接、监听传入数据、发送与接收消息，以及检查连接是否仍然可用。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that enables laboratory control software to communicate with instruments or network services over a TCP/IP socket. It handles opening and closing the connection, listening for incoming data, transmitting and receiving messages, and checking whether the connection is still available.

A non-physical software component that enables laboratory control software to communicate with instruments or network services over a TCP/IP socket. It handles opening and closing the connection, listening for incoming data, transmitting and receiving messages, and checking whether the connection is still available.
